title: States Face SNAP Payment Accuracy Deadline
discussion_signal: The administrative relay focuses on payment-error thresholds, state deadlines, and the operational work needed to protect access, illustrating that processing timeliness and payment accuracy are distinct from participation counts.
linked_research_question: How do administrative routes, payment accuracy, and direct-access design shape SNAP receipt independently of underlying household eligibility or security?
